name: AjaxPress – Fast AJAX Navigation & Speed Optimization Plugin
author: Jafran Hasan

sections.description:
AjaxPress adds lightning-fast AJAX navigation and instant page transitions to your website — giving it the feel of a Single Page Application (SPA).
No complicated setup. No bloated scripts. Just a rocket-fast, smooth browsing experience built for speed optimization and performance.

Whether you run a blog, store, portfolio, or community site, AjaxPress keeps visitors engaged with seamless navigation and instant content loading.

✨ Key Features

  • 🚀 Fast AJAX Navigation – Navigate instantly without reloading the page.
  • ⚙️ Speed Optimization – Loads only what’s needed for maximum performance.
  • 💨 Instant Page Load – Every click feels immediate.
  • 💬 AJAX Forms & Comments – Submit instantly without page refresh.
  • 🪶 Lightweight Architecture – Zero bloat, built purely for performance.
  • 🎨 Theme Compatible – Works smoothly with almost every theme.
  • 🛒 E-Commerce Ready – Blazing-fast product navigation for stores.
  • 🔄 SPA-Like Browsing – Experience the magic of a Single Page Application.
  • 🌍 Translation Ready – Includes .pot file for localization.

Why Choose AjaxPress

Traditional websites reload entire pages with each click — wasting time and resources.
AjaxPress uses intelligent AJAX loading to update only the content that changes, dramatically improving speed, performance, and user satisfaction.

Perfect for:
– 📝 Blogs & Magazines – instant article switching
– 🏢 Business & Agency Sites – fast, polished transitions
– 🛒 Stores – quick product browsing and checkout
– 🎨 Portfolios – smooth project displays
– 💬 Forums & Communities – real-time topic updates

Works Great With:
Elementor, WooCommerce, Contact Form 7, Rank Math, Yoast SEO, WP Rocket, LiteSpeed Cache, Cloudflare, and more.

sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins → Add New.
  2. Search for AjaxPress.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  4. Done — your site now runs on fast AJAX navigation.
  5. Optional: Visit Settings → AjaxPress to customize animations, exclusions, and caching behavior.
sections.faq:
⚡ How does AjaxPress improve speed and performance?

AjaxPress loads only the dynamic parts of your site using AJAX. This reduces page reloads, cuts server requests, and delivers faster performance.

🧩 Does it work with my theme and other plugins?

Yes! AjaxPress integrates seamlessly with most themes and popular plugins like Elementor, WooCommerce, and SEO tools.

🚀 Is AjaxPress lightweight?

Absolutely. The plugin is built from scratch with no heavy libraries — pure performance focus.

🌐 Does it work with caching or CDN services?

Yes. AjaxPress works perfectly with Cloudflare, LiteSpeed, WP Rocket, and other optimization plugins.

💬 Do forms and comments work with AJAX?

Yes. Submissions happen instantly without refreshing the page.

🔄 Is this a Single Page Application (SPA)?

Yes — AjaxPress brings an SPA-like experience without complex frameworks.

🪶 Can I exclude certain pages or post types?

Of course. You can easily exclude URLs or post types in AjaxPress settings.

💥 Will it conflict with page builders?

No. AjaxPress respects scripts and inline assets used by Elementor, Divi, or Gutenberg.

🆘 Need help?

Visit our Support Forum for assistance or to report issues.
